name: XCC_CB_KEY_SEG_TREE_VERSIONS_
description: This is the audit table for XCC_CB_KEY_SEG_TREE_VERSIONS which stores the tree label and tree versions assigned to a control budget key segment over different periods.

columns.name: KEY_SEG_TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for this transaction

columns.name: KEY_SEGMENT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to XCC_CB_KEY_SEGMENTS table

columns.name: START_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: The start period for the tree detail record

columns.name: END_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: The end period for the tree detail record

columns.name: START_EFF_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Effective period number of the start period of the tree detail record

columns.name: END_EFF_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Effective period number of the end period of the tree detail record

columns.name: TREE_LABEL_ID
columns.description: Tree label of the flexfield segment tree

columns.name: TREE_LABEL_DATA_SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Data source for the tree content for a given tree label

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Tree version of the flexfield segment tree

columns.name: IN_USE_START_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Start period for the tree detail record when the control budget status was In Use the last time.

columns.name: IN_USE_END_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: End period for the tree detail record when the control budget status was In Use the last time.

columns.name: IN_USE_TREE_LABEL_ID
columns.description: Tree label of the flexfield segment tree when the control budget status was In Use the last time.

columns.name: IN_USE_TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Tree version of the flexfield segment tree when the control budget status was In Use the last time.

columns.name: RECALC_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a recalculation program needs to run for this tree detail record.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
